privacyPolicy.title: Tikoncha Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: The Tikoncha project respects the privacy of its users and considers ensuring data security as its top priority. This Privacy Policy provides information about what data is collected, how it is used, and how it is protected when using the Tikoncha app and platform.

dataCollection.title: 1. What Data is Collected
dataCollection.description: The Tikoncha app may use the following types of data:
items: Technical data necessary for proper app functionality
General usage statistics (time and activity metrics)
dataCollection.note: Tikoncha does not read or store personal conversations, messages, media files, or user content.

dataUsage.title: 2. Purpose of Data Usage
dataUsage.description: Collected data is used for the following purposes:
items: Ensuring proper and stable app functionality
Providing parents with convenient access to restrictions and statistics set for their children
dataUsage.note: Data is not used for tracking or profiling users.

parentalControl.title: 3. Parental Control
parentalControl.description: The Tikoncha app operates with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. All important settings and permissions are managed only by the parent or responsible person. Parents may receive notifications about their child's logout attempts or attempts to change important settings.

dataProtection.title: 4. Data Storage and Protection
items: Not selling or sharing it with third parties
Using it only within app functionality
dataProtection.note: Technical and organizational measures are implemented to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse of data.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.description: The app may use third-party technologies for certain functions (such as error detection or technical stability). These services only use necessary technical data and also comply with privacy requirements.

userRights.title: 6. User Rights
userRights.description: Parents and users have the right to:
items: Delete their account or stop using the app

policyChanges.title: 7. Changes to Privacy Policy
policyChanges.description: Tikoncha may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be announced on official platforms and will take effect from the date of publication.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.description: If you have questions about the Privacy Policy, you can contact us through official communication channels.
